question: Find Small Cell Lung trials with minimum follow‑up and show months by arm.

gemini.answer: This query retrieves SCLC trials along with follow-up durations, ordered by overall follow-up time descending to show trials with the maximum follow-up time first.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\", \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\", \"follow_up_duration_rx_months\", \"follow_up_duration_control_months\"\nFROM public.\"clinical_trials\"\nWHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%SCLC%'\nORDER BY \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\" DESC;",
  "answer": "This query retrieves SCLC trials along with follow-up durations, ordered by overall follow-up time descending to show trials with the maximum follow-up time first.",
  "assumptions": ""
}
```
